title: muND LT dataset file
description: One file of the LT sub-library (lifetimes of muonic atoms / nuclear capture rates). A file holds one metadata record - one publication, optionally split by a key - and all data entries that refer to it. The member names datasetId, datasetType, nuclide, observable, uncertainties and bibId follow the JSON Schema drafted for muND by S. Kawase (github.com/shkawase/mund). The order of the properties below is the canonical key order of the files.

sublibrary.description: Sub-library: XR, LT, ES or BR. This schema covers LT.

datasetType.description: experiment: data as published (directory EXP). theory: theoretical calculation (TH). curated: experimental data re-analysed on a common footing, traced back to experiment (CUR). evaluated: recommended data (EVAL).

data.description: Data entries. One entry per line in the file.

forbidden.description: A member that is not allowed here.

bibId.description: A source: its DOI as DOI:<DOI>; without a DOI, its keynumber in Nuclear Science References as NSR:<keynumber>; found in neither, a muND key muND:<name>.

key.description: Short label that distinguishes entries which would otherwise get the same ID. Compared case-insensitively. Must not contain '|'.

meta.description: Metadata record: the source and how the data were obtained. Bibliographic details are kept in data/master/bibliography.json and found through bibId.

id.description: MetaID, derived from datasetType, bibId and key. Data entries refer to their metadata by this identifier.

bibId.description: Main reference: its DOI, NSR keynumber or muND key. Part of the MetaID.

key.description: Optional. Separates several metadata records of the same publication (e.g. two different set-ups). Part of the MetaID.

relatedBibIds.description: Other identifiers of the same work: arXiv version, erratum, data repository ...

facility.description: experiment only. Short name of the facility as listed in data/master/facilities.json (e.g. 'J-PARC (D1)').

method.description: experiment: what was detected (electron, gamma, neutron, charged particle, fission fragment). theory: model or code. curated / evaluated: procedure, including the constants and Huff factors it used.

beam.description: experiment only. Beam conditions: a short summary written for this database from the source, not a quotation (free text).

target.description: experiment only. Target: size, gas / liquid / solid, chemical form, enrichment ... A short summary written for this database from the source, not a quotation (free text).

detector.description: experiment only. Detector set-up: a short summary written for this database from the source, not a quotation (free text).

software.description: theory, curated and evaluated only. Program and version that produced the values (e.g. a code name with its version or commit).

referenceDatabase.description: evaluated only. The set of curated data the evaluation is based on (e.g. a version of the curated library).

comment.description: Any other remark, e.g. corrections applied, reference data used.

entry.description: One data entry: one quantity of one nuclide.

datasetId.description: DataID, derived from datasetType, element, mass, MetaID and key.

key.description: Optional. Separates entries of the same nuclide within one metadata record (e.g. two target forms). Part of the DataID.

originalData.description: curated (required) / evaluated (optional): the entries this value was derived from, each with the entryHash it had when it was used. A later change of such an entry is reported until this entry has been checked again and the new entryHash recorded.

legacyIds.description: Earlier identifiers of this entry; references to them still resolve.

corrections.description: Corrections made to this entry after it was first recorded, oldest first. The entry shows the corrected content; each record keeps what it was before, why it was changed and whether the change was checked against the publication.

entryHash.description: Content hash of the original entry (its nuclide and observable as written) at the time it was used; see docs/id-definition.md.

date.description: When the correction was made (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM).

pointer.description: JSON pointer, within the entry, of the member that was corrected (e.g. /nuclide/element).

before.description: The member as it was before the correction.

formerId.description: datasetId the entry had before the correction, when the correction changed it and the earlier identifier is not one of legacyIds (e.g. because it belonged to another entry).

checkedAgainstSource.description: true: the correction was checked against the publication. false: not yet (e.g. inferred from the data).

mass.description: Mass number A. 0 means a target of natural isotopic abundance.

isomer.description: 0 = ground state. Format version 1 holds ground states only.

observable.description: The measured or calculated quantity. 'kind' names it; the member of the same name holds value, unit and uncertainties. experiment and theory entries keep the quantity given in the source (the one closest to the original); curated and evaluated entries are capture_rate.

kind.description: lifetime: total lifetime of the muonic atom. capture_rate: total nuclear capture rate. capture_probability: fraction of muons captured by the nucleus.

value.description: Value as given in the source, written with the same number of digits.

unit.description: ASCII units: ns, us (microsecond) for lifetime; us-1 (per microsecond), ms-1, s-1 for capture rate; % for capture probability.

uncertainties.description: Uncertainties (one standard deviation, symmetric) as given in the source, statistical and systematic separately when the source separates them. A single overall uncertainty has source 'total'. Empty when the source gives none.

huffFactor.description: Optional. Huff factor the source used to convert between lifetime and capture rate (information only).
